title: Rudy
html_source: Bloom and Molly’s son Rudy died soon after birth. Bloom still thinks of him often and has not been able to enjoy a normal sex life in the ten or eleven years since Rudy died.

anchor.prefix: she was born, running to knock up Mrs Thornton in Denzille street.1932#58 Jolly old woman. Lots of babies she must have helped into the world. She knew from the first poor little
